title: Integral boundary of the ordinary positive finite Kummer arrow
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, X,S Noetherian, e:X≅P¹_S, l invertible on S, n a finite coefficient level, k the specified Kummer sequence on X, and c section-normalized coefficient coordinates. The independently defined ordinary arrow finiteP1OrdinaryKummerArrow of [def-sfb-finite-p1-kummer-coordinates] satisfies FiniteKummerBoundary of [def-sfb-finite-kummer-boundary-equation] for k and e*O(1). There is no tower Chern arrow, no FiniteChernNormalization hypothesis, no arbitrary target isomorphism, and no requested realization equality in this assertion.

theorem finiteP1_ordinary_kummer_boundary
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (k : Kummer l X)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    {hX : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤))}
    (c : SpTowerP1.CoefficientCoordinates l E n X hX) :
    FiniteKummerBoundary l E X n k
      (Scheme.Pic.mapHom e.hom (hyperplanePic S))
      (finiteP1OrdinaryKummerArrow l E n e hS c)
